## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one issue and follows its accepted specification/RFC.
- [ ] Tests, schemas, public docs, and generated artifacts are synchronized.
- [ ] Numerical or generated evidence was regenerated canonically and reviewed semantically.
- [ ] Public claims are supported by checked-in evidence and red results remain visible.
- [ ] New third-party code/data includes its origin, license, and required notices.
- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by` trailer for DCO 1.1 certification.
- [ ] User-visible behavior has an appropriate changelog entry when the changelog exists.
